## Purpose
GitHub-specific configuration trunk. Currently houses only CI workflow definitions consumed by GitHub Actions.

## Subdirectories
- `workflows/` — GitHub Actions workflow definitions (currently just `test.yml` running `npm test` on push/PR). See `workflows/README.md` for detail.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- Root `package.json` — workflows invoke `npm test`, so the `test` script there is load-bearing for CI.
- Hook implementations under `tools/` — CI exercises them, which is why workflows set a dummy git identity.
